Perfect! I can see the issue clearly. The pod is stuck in Pending because the PersistentVolume (PV) it needs is bound to the failed node. The volume has node affinity that restricts it to `ip-10-0-7-21.ec2.internal`, which is the node that failed. The error message confirms this: "8 node(s) had volume node affinity conflict."

Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to understand the options for handling this situation:
